Three.js r128 (0.128.0)
Copyright 2010-2021 Three.js Authors
License: MIT
Source: https://unpkg.com/three@0.128.0/ (downloaded 2026-10-22)

Files in this folder:
- three.min.js (core, r128)
- EffectComposer.js, RenderPass.js, ShaderPass.js, UnrealBloomPass.js
- CopyShader.js, LuminosityHighPassShader.js
These post-processing addons are from the same three.js r128 distribution
(examples/js). They are loaded as classic scripts and expose THREE.* globals.

The library is bundled locally so the game runs from a local HTTP server
without any external CDN. No network requests are made at runtime.
